about.heading: Local services you can
about.lede: Verified providers, the price up front, and payment only after the provider confirms the time.
about.missionTitle: Make hiring a service as simple and as safe as buying in a shop.
about.mission1: In Mozambique, finding a good plumber, a hairdresser or a tutor still depends on knowing someone. The price is agreed over the phone and, when it goes wrong, there is nobody to turn to.
about.mission2: On Ntizo, every provider is verified, every service shows its price, and every booking is on record, from the time agreed to the payment.
about.howTitle: Three steps. Paying is the last.

search.title: Search and compare
search.body: By category and city, with the price, the reviews and the verified badge.

book.title: Book the time
book.body: Pick the day and time on the provider's calendar. They confirm it.

pay.title: Pay after confirmation
pay.body: The payment prompt reaches your phone only after the provider confirms the time.

about.customersTitle: Find, book and pay in one place.
about.providersTitle: Your calendar, your prices, your customers.

contact.heading: Talk to us.
contact.lede: Partnerships, press, a question about the platform, or simply a hello. We reply on working days.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what is on your mind.

feedback.heading: Tell us what you think.
feedback.lede: An idea, something that did not work, or something you liked. We read all of it, and it is what decides what we build next.
feedback.messagePlaceholder: What would you like to be different? If something failed, tell us where you were and what you expected.

careers.heading: Build Ntizo with us.
careers.lede: We are a small team building the infrastructure for local services in Mozambique.
careers.building1: A marketplace where a customer finds, books and pays for a service with confidence, and where a provider has a calendar, prices and payments without needing a company behind them.
careers.building2: We started with Mozambique, with M-Pesa and in Portuguese, designed from day one for other countries, currencies and languages.

how.title: We write before we build.
how.body: Every decision has a document with the why.

how.title: We ship early and fix fast.
how.body: A real version in a customer's hands beats a perfect one in a presentation.

how.title: Whoever uses it comes first.
how.body: We talk to providers and customers before deciding for them.

careers.openingsBody: If you think we should be talking anyway, write to us: what you do well, what you have built, and why Ntizo.
